data.body:
Fix applied to plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md (Phase E Step 3 + Phase H Step 1):

1. Added explicit Multi-commit RED→GREEN discipline block to Phase E Step 3 (Fix Implementation). When a fix spans ≥2 atomic commits across multiple axes, the fix sub-agent MUST independently demonstrate RED→GREEN for each behavioral commit: write RED test first, run it (capture failure), implement the fix, confirm GREEN, then commit. Batching test+implementation into a single commit and reporting 'GREEN at end' is now explicitly prohibited.

2. Added RED_TEST_FAILED_AS_EXPECTED as a REQUIRED field in the FIX_RESULT reporting block (Phase H Step 1). Valid values: yes | no | n/a (llm-behavioral) | n/a (testing_mode=GREEN). Also added red_captures field for multi-commit fixes to surface per-axis failure summaries.

Root cause of the original gap: Phase E Step 3 said 'One logical change at a time' but did not define that each logical change requires its own RED→GREEN cycle before committing. The single-commit RED requirement in Phase E Step 1/Step 2 was implicitly scoped to the whole fix rather than explicitly per-commit. The DIG-1939 dispatch (5492-58d7) demonstrated the failure mode: 4 commits landed with tests passing but no per-commit RED captures reported.

Classification: LLM-behavioral, affecting orchestrator behavior when constructing multi-commit fix dispatch prompts.
